objective: Reserve WAL replay's aggregate entry buffer from each non-empty segment's bounded file-size hint.

tasks.title: Reserve WAL replay aggregate entries
tasks.result: WAL replay now reserves the aggregate entry vector from each segment's bounded replay-entry capacity hint before extending it.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The reserve amount reuses the existing bounded replay_entry_capacity_hint(file_len).
The optimization only changes aggregate Vec capacity during replay; WAL record decoding, ordering, truncation, and persistence semantics are unchanged.
